title: Your First Hello World
description: Write a program that prints 'Hello World from Java!' to the console. Make sure the class is named exactly 'HolaMundo'.
hints: The text must go inside double quotes
Don't forget the semicolon at the end of each statement
solutionExplanation: We declare the HolaMundo class with the main method (entry point). We use System.out.println() to print the message to the console. Every statement ends with a semicolon.

title: Personal Introduction with Java
description: Create a program that prints your name, the subject you study, and why you like programming, using three separate lines.
hints: Each println() call automatically adds a line break
solutionExplanation: Each System.out.println() prints a different line. The println method automatically adds a line break at the end, so each message appears on its own line.
expectedOutput:
My name is Carlos
I study Systems Engineering
I like programming because I can create solutions

title: System Information with Java Properties
description: Create a program that uses System.getProperty() to get and display: the operating system name, the Java version, and the current user.
hints: Concatenate with + to create descriptive messages
solutionExplanation: System.getProperty() accesses system properties. We store each value in a String variable and then print it concatenated with a descriptive label.
expectedOutput:
Operating System: Windows 11
Java Version: 21.0.1
User: carlos
